items.title: Ukraine's Sine Engineering launches joint defense tech initiative with Finland

items.teaser: Nach dem tödlichen Angriff auf israelische Soldaten in der Stadt Hebron hat die Armee nach eigenen Angaben eine Anti-Terror-Operation im Westjordanland gestartet. Dazu gehört unter anderem die Abriegelung der Stadt Hebron.

items.title: One killed, 18 injured in Russian attacks in Chernihiv region over past day
items.teaser: A man was killed and 18 other people were injured in Russian strikes on an enterprise in the Chernihiv region on October 23.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 181 Gefechte an der Front: Der Feind setzt über 10.000 Drohnen ein
items.teaser: Am 23. Oktober kam es zu 181 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front, die Mehrheit davon Richtung Kostjantyniwka.

items.title: Starlink and Starshield operating at speeds above 161 km/h – source
items.teaser: As of the morning of October 24, the Starlink and Starshield satellite communication systems were operating at speeds above 161 km/h.

items.title: Russian strikes injure seven people in Kharkiv region, including two children

items.teaser: The next round of talks between Ukraine, the US and Russia could take place in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland in a couple of weeks, according to US government sources.

items.title: Drones attack Russia's Tolyattikauchuk plant producing components for rocket fuel – media
items.teaser: A fire broke out at the Tolyattikauchuk plant in Russia's Samara region overnight into Saturday, October 24, following a drone attack. The plant produces, among other things, synthetic rubber used in solid rocket fuel.

items.title: Starlink is working again at speeds above 161 km/h – UP sources

items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 24. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.576.600 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 1980 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,576,600 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022

items.title: War update: 181 clashes on front lines over past day, heaviest fighting on Kostiantynivka axis
items.teaser: A total of 181 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front line on October 23, with the heaviest fighting on the Kostiantynivka axis.

items.title: Russian attacks on three Ukrainian oblasts kill two people and injure 27

items.title: Partisans destroy communications tower in Russia's Belgorod region
items.teaser: Agents of the ATESH partisan movement destroyed a communications tower near the settlement of Shebekino in Russia's Belgorod region, disrupting the operation of a repeater that Russian troops used to maintain a stable signal and guide and control drones.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw: Zwei Verletzte, Wohnhaus beschädigt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff am Morgen auf Kyjiw wurden zwei Menschen verletzt.

items.title: Russian forces attack Ukraine with 126 drones, strikes recorded at 14 locations
items.teaser: Russia launched 126 drones against Ukraine overnight, including 61 jet-powered Shaheds. Ukraine's air defences recorded strikes at 14 locations, while debris from downed drones fell at five others.

items.title: Russian army loses 1,980 troops, two air defense systems in Ukraine war over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to October 24, 2026, have reached approximately 1,576,600 personnel, including 1,980 killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Trump floats possibility of imposing 200% tariffs on Ukraine and Russia to force peace
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has said the United States could impose 200% tariffs on Ukraine and Russia to force them to end the war.

items.title: Fire breaks out at Russian chemical plant in Tolyatti after drone attack – photos, videos
items.teaser: Russian Telegram channels have reported a fire at the Tolyattikauchuk synthetic rubber plant in Tolyatti following a drone attack. There have also been reports of a possible evacuation at AvtoVAZ.

items.title: Mass blackouts reported across occupied Crimea
items.teaser: According to satellite imagery from NASA FIRMS, the Taman substation in Russia's Krasnodar Krai — a key energy node supplying electricity to Crimea —was damaged in an overnight attack.

items.title: Russian drone attack damages house in Kyiv, injures two
items.teaser: A private residential house was damaged during a Russian drone attack on Kyiv this morning, injuring two people.

items.title: Large-scale blackout hits Crimea after drone attack
items.teaser: A large-scale blackout affected the entire temporarily occupied Crimean peninsula overnight on October 24. The occupation authorities reported damage to energy infrastructure across the peninsula.

items.title: Rubio reveals theory on Russia's war against Ukraine ahead of next US peace push
items.teaser: "People keep talking about it's a war in Ukraine. ... It's about one region of the country," U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said.

items.title: Russia loses 1,980 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,980 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: One killed, six injured in Russian airstrike on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Russian forces dropped three FAB-250 aerial bombs on Kramatorsk on the afternoon of October 23, killing one person and injuring six others, including three children.

items.title: US lawmakers urge Pentagon to expand Starshield contract for Ukraine
items.teaser: A bipartisan, bicameral group of US lawmakers has called on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to expand the Pentagon's Starshield contract and ensure uninterrupted access to Starlink and Starshield for Ukrainian forces following recent disruptions.

items.title: Russian attack on Kyiv injures two people and damages house
items.teaser: Two people were injured after a Russian drone attack damaged a house in Kyiv in the morning.

items.title: Russia launched 2,597 drones at Ukraine over past week, air defenses neutralized over 87%
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized nearly 2,300 Russian attack drones over the past week, achieving an interception rate of more than 87%.

items.title: Zelensky 'maybe not such a big humanitarian as Putin,' he quips as Ukraine's relations with Trump unravel
items.teaser: The president made the comment in an interview with ABC News two days after U.S. Envoy Steve Witkoff praised Vladimir Putin as "a humanitarian." Hours later, Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles and cluster munitions.

items.title: Israel startet "Anti-Terror-Operation" im Westjordanland
items.teaser: Am Abend beginnt Israels Armee eigenen Angaben zufolge einen Einsatz gegen Terroristen im Westjordanland.

items.teaser: Republican and Democratic senators have warned the White House they will hold up confirmation votes until Trump's administration restores critical satellite communications used by Ukrainian troops, amid growing tensions over US policy towards Russia.

items.title: Ukraine repatriates seven more civilians in exchange with Russia
items.teaser: Ukraine has managed to bring home seven more civilians as part of a prisoner exchange with Russia.

items.title: Zelenskyy: We are ready to end this war as quickly as possible
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Kyiv is prepared to reach a peace deal to end the war as soon as possible, but will not recognise Russian-occupied Ukrainian territory as Russian.

items.title: Nach Anschlag auf Soldaten: Israel startet Operation im Westjordanland
items.teaser: Nach den tödlichen Schüssen auf zwei Soldaten hat Israels Armee einen "Anti-Terror-Einsatz" im Westjordanland begonnen. Man suche dort nach Waffen und Terrorinfrastruktur. Israels Premier drohte zudem mit einem großagelegten Militäreinsatz.

items.title: Drug parcels: Teen girl suspected of poisoning Ukrainian servicemen detained in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: Police in the Zhytomyr region have detained a 17-year-old girl who, according to investigators, helped Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) poison Ukrainian servicemen.

items.title: Rassistischer Terroranschlag?: Nach Schüssen bei Paris - Ermittler finden Sprengfalle
items.teaser: Nach dem Schussangriff bei Paris spricht Frankreichs Präsident Macron von einem "Wendepunkt" und vermutet einen "rassistischen Terroranschlag". Die Ermittler stoßen in der Wohnung des Verdächtigen auf eine Sprengfalle. Im Auto finden sie ein Maschinengewehr.

items.title: Nahost - Israel startet "Anti-Terror-Operation" im Westjordanland nach tödlichem Schusswaffenangriff in Hebron

items.title: This is the fancy new F-16 Ukraine could get. It’s not what its pilots need most.

items.title: Ukraine now fights two enemies. One is America

items.teaser: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the war centres on Russia's attempts to seize Donbas, while Ukraine refuses to give up the territory over concerns about its sovereignty and long-term security.

items.title: Russian airstrikes on Kramatorsk kill one person and injure six, including three children – photo

items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine seeks an open dialogue with the U.S. and other partners so that the world can better understand the situation in Ukraine and political leaders can make decisions that will bring peace closer.

items.title: Chmara und schwedischer Verteidigungsminister erörtern Folgen russischer Angriffe und Luftverteidigung
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Verteidigungsminister Jewhen Chmara hatte ein Gespräch mit seinem schwedischen Amtskollegen Pål Jonson. Dabei erörterten sie die Folgen der russischen Angriffe und die Notwendigkeit, den ukrainischen Luftraum zu schützen.

items.title: Finland donates 10 diesel locomotives to Ukraine
items.teaser: Finland has become the first country to donate locomotives to Ukrzaliznytsia, signing an agreement to transfer 10 Dv12 diesel locomotives and spare parts.

items.title: Drones attack Azot chemical plant in Russia's Perm region – media
items.teaser: Drones struck Russia's Azot chemical plant in the Perm region on the morning of Friday, October 23.

items.title: Russische Schiffe im Verdacht: Spionage an britischen Unterseekabeln
items.teaser: Unterseekabel gelten als mögliche Ziele russischer Spionage. Eine Recherche deckt verdächtige Vorfälle auf, die die Sorge vor Angriffen auf kritische Infrastruktur verstärken.

items.title: The Telegraph names five candidates for role of negotiators with Russia on ending war in Ukraine
items.teaser: The Telegraph reports that Europe is selecting potential negotiators for peace talks with Russia, with five European leaders currently being considered.

items.title: Ukraine has not confirmed lifting of Starlink/Starshield speed limits
items.teaser: The Ministry of Defence of Ukraine continues to record interruptions in the operation of Starlink/Starshield terminals on the front line.

items.title: Over half a million Ukrainians left without power after Russian attacks
items.teaser: More than 500,000 Ukrainians have been left without electricity as a result of Russian attacks on energy infrastructure overnight and on the morning of 23 October.

items.title: Nach Festnahme in Brandenburg - Hier fährt der mutmaßliche Russen-Spion zum Richter

items.teaser: Russian troops have attacked an enterprise in the Dnipro district, injuring two people.

items.title: US Senator Blumenthal opens probe into Ukraine Starshield restrictions
items.teaser: "This decision to limit critical technology for a key ally... (puts) Ukrainian forces at risk and their people in peril," Senator Richard Blumenthal wrote in a letter addressed to U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

items.title: Russian attacks leave nearly 105,000 customers without power in Volyn region, one person injured
items.teaser: A person was injured and nearly 105,000 electricity customers were left without power in the Volyn region following Russian drone attacks.

items.title: Abwahl unwahrscheinlicher: Asien unterstützt Infantino
items.teaser: Die Front gegen den umstrittenen FIFA-Chef Gianni Infantino bröckelt. Auf dem Kongress des Fußball-Verbandes Asiens erhält der Schweizer Rückendeckung.

items.title: Nach "großem Anschlag": Israel lässt Westjordanland "vollständig" abriegeln
items.teaser: Nach einem Schusswaffenangriff nahe der Stadt Hebron im Westjordanland kündigt Israels Regierung weitreichende Sicherheitsmaßnahmen an. Im Zuge mehrerer Razzien wird das palästinensische Gebiet abgeriegelt.

items.title: Ukrainian, Norwegian defense ministers discuss urgent increase in interceptor missile stocks
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and his Norwegian counterpart, Tore Sandvik, have discussed Ukraine's critical need for interceptor missiles.

items.title: Spirits from "unfriendly" countries to become much more expensive in Russia
items.teaser: The Russian authorities are planning to increase import duties on spirits from "unfriendly" countries from €3 to €5 per litre.

items.title: Finnland stellt der Ukraine zehn Lokomotiven und zusätzliche Winterhilfe bereit – Ministerpräsident
items.teaser: Finnland wird der Ukraine nach den russischen Angriffen zehn Lokomotiven zur Unterstützung des Bahnverkehrs liefern, fünf Millionen Euro für den Energiesektor und zusätzlich zwei Millionen Euro für humanitäre Hilfe zur Vorbereitung auf den Winter bereitstellen.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1702: Ukraine says Poland paused military aid package over Lviv vote honoring WWII nationalists
items.teaser: On the ground, Ukrainian forces went more than 15 kilometers underground to capture over 30 Russian soldiers.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facility, civilian infrastructure in Odesa region overnight
items.teaser: Russian invaders attacked an energy facility belonging to DTEK Odesa Power Grids and civilian infrastructure in the southern part of the Odesa region overnight.

items.title: "Ich habe mir mein eigenes Bein amputiert"
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Soldat Kostiantyn Vlasenko konnte mit einer Drohne von der Kriegsfront gerettet werden. Nun erzählt er von den 491 Tagen an der Front.

items.title: Russen töten zwei und verletzen neun Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 22. Oktober töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk zwei Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: US offers Russia Nord Stream restart as part of peace deal
items.teaser: The US is proposing to restart Nord Stream and resume Russian gas supplies to Europe as an economic incentive for Moscow as part of a potential peace deal.

items.title: Russian forces attack Rivne region overnight, leaving parts of region without power
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked the Rivne region throughout the evening and night, targeting energy infrastructure, residential areas and businesses.

items.title: Russians strike business in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, medics helping those injured
items.teaser: Two people have been injured following a Russian attack on the Dnipro district in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast on the morning of 23 October.

items.title: In Region Cherson zwei Zivilisten, darunter ein Kind, verletzt, 25 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 25 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurden zwei Zivilisten, darunter ein Kind, verletzt.

items.title: Russians strike railway infrastructure in Poltava
items.teaser: Firefighters responded to a fire after Russian forces struck a railway facility in Poltava. No casualties have been reported.

items.title: European Parliament calls on EU to launch naval operation in Black Sea
items.teaser: The European Parliament is asking the EU to consider deploying a naval operation in the Black Sea due to Russian attacks on civilian merchant ships.

items.title: Russian forces attack gas station in Sumy, injuring two employees
items.teaser: A warehouse and a gas station were damaged in an Russian overnight attack by a Geran-2 UAV in the Kovpakivskyi district of Sumy on October 23, leaving two people injured.

items.title: Wadephul reist in die Türkei: Ein halber Tag für die großen Krisen
items.teaser: Die Straße von Hormus, die Angriffe der Huthi, der Ukraine-Krieg - auf der Suche nach Wegen aus diesen Konflikten trifft sich Außenminister Wadephul in Istanbul in ungewöhnlicher Runde. Entstehen dort neue Allianzen? Von K. Willinger.

items.title: War update: 165 clashes on front lines over past day
items.teaser: A total of 165 combat engagements between Ukrainian forces and Russian troops were recorded on October 22, with the fiercest fighting recorded in the Pokrovsk and Southern Slobozhanshchyna sectors.

items.title: Luftabwehr schießt ab/neutralisiert 140 russische Kamikaze-Drohnen
items.teaser: Die Luftverteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben 140 russische Angriffsdrohnen neutralisiert, ließ die Luftwaffe der Streitkräfte der Ukraine im Online-Dienst Telegram melden.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,574,620 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,830 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure and homes in Zhytomyr region overnight
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked energy facilities and residential buildings in the Zhytomyr region overnight on October 23.

items.title: Total of 165 combat clashes occur on battlefield – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: A total of 165 combat clashes have occurred on the battlefield over the past day, with the Russians conducting the majority of their attacks on the Pivdennoslobozhanskyi and Pokrovsk fronts.

items.title: Ukraine’s air defenses down 140 out of 176 Russian drones overnight
items.teaser: Air defense forces neutralized 140 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine overnight on October 23. Hits were recorded at 19 locations.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 46 Ortschaften beschossen, drei Zivilisten getötet, einer verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 46 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 940 Mal.

items.title: Trump: Musk hat Starlink-Drosselung aufgehoben
items.teaser: SpaceX-Gründer Musk hat die Drosselung des Satelliteninternets Starlink für die Ukraine aufgehoben - das behauptet US-Präsident Trump. Aus Kiew kam dazu bislang keine Bestätigung.

items.title: Musk's Starshield system 'back' in Ukraine, says Trump
items.teaser: Trump said that he did not want to comment on who called for capping Starshield for Ukraine, but that Musk had "put it back."

items.title: Ukrainian air defence destroys 140 Russian drones overnight
items.teaser: Russia launched 176 drones against Ukraine overnight. Ukraine's air defences destroyed or jammed 140 of them, while 10 attack drones remained in Ukrainian airspace as of 08:00.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipro and region nearly 20 times since evening, two injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Dnipro and the surrounding region with drones nearly 20 times, injuring two people.

items.title: Ukraine and Finland agree to secure additional funding for shelter construction
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo have agreed to mobilise additional funding to build shelters across Ukraine, with Finland also proposing an international meeting of the 16 countries involved in the Shelter Coalition.

items.title: 1830 Soldaten - Kampfverluste der Russen am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 23. Oktober 2026 werden auf etwa 1.574620 (+1830 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Russians launch massive attack on DTEK thermal power plant
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a massive attack on one of DTEK’s thermal power plants, forcing it to halt electricity generation.

items.title: Russians launch major attack on Ukraine's thermal power plant, halting electricity generation
items.teaser: A DTEK thermal power plant has stopped generating electricity after Russian forces heavily damaged its equipment. The company has not disclosed which station was hit.

items.title: Russian drone attack injures 9 people, including 2 children
items.teaser: "Russia continues its deliberate terror against the peaceful Zhytomyr Oblast," regional Governor Vitalii Bunechko wrote on Telegram.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,830 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian troops from February 24, 2022, to October 23, 2026, reached approximately 1,574,620 personnel, including 1,830 Russian troops lost over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces neutralize 408,000 Russian drones since start of year
items.teaser: Units of Ukraine’s Defense Forces have struck 408,000 Russian unmanned aerial vehicles since the beginning of the year.

items.title: No negotiated peace possible while Putin in power – Hudson Institute President
items.teaser: Russian President Vladimir Putin’s rule depends on continuing the war, so the West needs a strategy focused on strengthening Ukraine, deterring Russia and preparing for change after Putin leaves power.

items.title: Lubinets says upholding human rights during war is a matter of survival
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Ombudsman has categorically rejected statements by some politicians that upholding the Constitution and human rights is “not a priority” during wartime.

items.title: Russia loses 1,830 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,830 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russian forces launch massive drone attack on Sumy, leaving two people injured
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a massive drone attack on Sumy overnight on October 23, injuring at least two people and damaging civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Russian disinformation campaign targets pro-Ukraine candidates ahead of midterms, lawmakers say
items.teaser: Russia is running a covert online disinformation campaign targeting U.S. politicians who support Ukraine, two Democratic lawmakers said on Oct. 21.

items.title: Wie steht die Linke zu Extremisten in den eigenen Reihen?
items.teaser: Die Koalitionsverhandlungen in Berlin werden von der Debatte um linksextremistische Bestrebungen in der Linkspartei überschattet. Auch in Leipzig gibt es Verbindungen zu einer vom Verfassungsschutz beobachteten Gruppe.

items.title: Trump soll Musk gebeten haben, die Starlink-Drosselung aufzuheben
items.teaser: Das ukrainische Militär beklagt eine Drosselung von Elon Musks Satelliteninternet. Laut einem Medienbericht soll Trump nun die Aufhebung befohlen haben. Der US-Präsident bezieht selbst Stellung dazu - doch viele Fragen bleiben offen.

items.title: Rosneft fears long-term damage from prolonged war in Ukraine – Bloomberg
items.teaser: Rosneft executives have expressed concern that even a few additional months of war in Ukraine could cause long-term damage to the business.

items.title: AP: Trump's administration gives conflicting accounts of restrictions on Ukraine's Starshield access
items.teaser: Disputed accounts from US officials and their allies have raised questions about who ordered restrictions on Ukraine's access to SpaceX's military satellite system and why, as Kyiv seeks answers about disruptions to its drone operations.

items.title: Lubinets on evacuation from Oleshky: “We're in home stretch”
items.teaser: In the temporarily occupied town of Oleshky in the Kherson region, the situation is critical and has effectively reached the brink of a humanitarian catastrophe. At the same time, Ukraine is practically in the home stretch of evacuating citizens who need to be evacuated.

items.title: Russians launch large-scale drone attack on Sumy, injuring civilians
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a large-scale drone attack on Sumy on 23 October, striking civilian infrastructure in three parts of the city and damaging houses in the Kovpakivskyi district.

items.title: Ukrainian Ruslan cargo aircraft catches fire at Japanese airport
items.teaser: An Antonov Airlines cargo aircraft caught fire while landing at Chubu Centrair International Airport in Japan. The runway was closed for 15 minutes as authorities investigated the incident.

items.title: Ukraine simplifies underground construction for defense industry companies
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has adopted a series of measures for the defense industry, including involving private businesses in the construction of industrial facilities, exempting components supplied by international partners from VAT and customs duties, and introducing a "single window" procedure for such goods.

items.title: Amid Starlink crisis, Finnish tech giants announce plan to help Ukraine build its own sovereign satellite system
items.teaser: "Ukraine needs secure, sovereign, and high-performance satellite communications systems that it controls," ICEYE CEO Rafal Modrzewski said in a press release announcing the deal with Kyiv.

items.title: Trypillia settlement discovered above Verteba Cave in Ternopil region
items.teaser: Scientists have discovered a Trypillia settlement on the surface above Verteba Cave in the Ternopil region during extensive magnetometric surveys using unmanned aerial vehicles at two Trypillia culture sites included on UNESCO's Tentative List of World Heritage Sites.

items.title: Trump's midterm election calculations are complicating US policy on Ukraine – Reuters
items.teaser: Donald Trump's changing approach to Russia's war against Ukraine comes as US voters grow increasingly concerned about energy prices and the cost of living ahead of the 3 November midterm elections.
